intent: Design tokens: color, space, radius, type, shadow, and motion primitives with semantic roles.
Primary action control for forms and dashboards.
Joined row of kit Buttons.
Single KPI tile with label, value, optional delta and trend.
Horizontal row of Scorecards for a metrics strip.
Single-line text entry with optional start and end slots inside the field.
A number the person can type, step, and read in their locale, with optional min and max.
A money amount with a currency symbol, locale formatting, min, max, and step.
One-time code / PIN as separate slots. Paste and autocomplete work. Not a row of Inputs.
A recommended insight or opportunity as a compact card, with tone and optional actions.
Change and progress over ordered samples as a line or area chart.
A column of links, one a row with a chevron at the end, like an account's quick links.
A list of records, one row each: primary and optional secondary line, leading avatar or icon, trailing badge, actions, or chevron.
Square dot-grid loading indicator for compact waits.
How far along or how full something is, from 0 to 100, as a bar, a ring, or a half ring, with optional red, amber, and green zones.
Multi-line text for notes. Wrap with Field.
Pick a time of day as hour and minute, in 12-hour or 24-hour form.
Choose one or several options from a short list. Field trigger, kit DropdownMenu panel.
Type to filter one value, including a list the parent loads asynchronously.
Choose several values. Selected values stay in the field as removable tags, and typing filters the list.
Animated text for short indeterminate processing copy.
Pick a value or range along a track.
Spinning circular loader for indeterminate waits.
Immediate on/off setting. Pill track, role=switch. Not a Checkbox.
Multi-select or confirmation control. Optional visible label.
Single show/hide panel.
Inline colour picker: saturation/brightness area, hue, optional opacity, hex input, and preset swatches.
Searchable command menu for quick actions.
Actions for one target, opened with a right-click or Shift+F10.
An editable table: people click a cell to add or change its content, like rule conditions, line items, or mappings.
Responsive structured data with search, filters, column settings, and clear empty states.
Form field that opens a month grid to pick one date or a date range.
Pick a date range from named presets such as This month or Last 30 days, or from the month grid.
Pick a calendar date and a time in one field.
Read-only code block with copy, optional title, language label, tabs, and line numbers.
Thin rule that separates content, horizontal or vertical, with an optional label or action.
A full calendar of events by month, week, day, or list. Browse dates, filter calendars, add / edit / delete events.
Inline cell content for datasets: text, avatar, file, payment, badge, trend, avatar group, select, progress, rating, or row actions.
Column header for DataTable: label, optional select-all checkbox, sm or md.
Small help panel: optional title plus one to three short sentences.
A panel anchored to a trigger. Click opens it. Escape and a click outside close it.
Framed tile with optional header, body, and footer actions.
Paged track of slides with prev/next kit Buttons. One piece.
Arrows at both ends of a row or column that is too long to fit, so people can move it along without a scrollbar.
Small number badge for counts, like unread items on a nav link or tab.
Assistant panel with a header, a thread, and a composer. One piece.
Choose exactly one option from a small visible radio set.
Two panels split by a separator you can drag or resize from the keyboard.
One labeled control with optional hint and error. Label on top or start (left).
Drop zone plus file rows with progress, done, and error. Presentational: the app does the upload.
Semantic group of fields with a legend and optional description. This is the form group.
Filter chip for lists and tables: shows the filter name or its chosen value, opens its options, and turns an applied filter on or off.
A row of filter chips with add, clear all, and an overflow menu when the row is too long.
Label the user applies or manages: removable, selectable, with optional count, status dot, or avatar.
Tags the person types. Enter or a delimiter adds one. Optional suggestions.
Compact status or category pill.
Compare magnitudes across categories with vertical or horizontal bars.
Path to the current page as a hierarchy of links.
Brief supplementary text on hover or focus.
Switch between related views in place. Line by default, or segmented, in lg, md, and sm.
Dismissible overlay for short tasks, forms, or extra detail. Composes ModalCard. Not a must-choose confirm.
The panel chrome for a modal (title, body, footer). Use inside Modal, or standalone in docs. Not a page Card.
Edge panel for secondary tasks that need more room than a Modal.
Actions or value menu from a button, field, or nav trigger.
Placeholder when a list, page, or region has nothing to show.
Horizontal site nav. Dropdowns are kit DropdownMenu. Not SideNav. Not AppNav.
Rolling number treatment for live metrics and counters.
Top-of-page title with optional Breadcrumb trail, subtitle, and actions.
Page navigation with previous, next, page numbers, and ellipsis. Not ButtonGroup. Not Tabs.
Part-to-whole share for a handful of segments, as a donut or solid pie.
Task completion as a bar or circle from 0 to 100. Optional label and percent.
Ordered wizard steps as numbered circles with complete, current, and upcoming.
Grouped page block with heading, optional description and actions. Unframed — Card owns the framed surface; layout-content owns page inset.
Product top chrome: brand mark, centered search, trailing actions. Preset, or AppHeader.Root building blocks.
Vertical sidebar navigation with active item state.
A list of the sections on one long page. It jumps to a section and shows the one the page is at.

Product side nav: brand header, icon items, optional badges, closeable; preset props or compose your own from SideNav.Root/Header/Brand/Toggle/Nav/Section/Item blocks. Not AppNav. Not an overlay itself: on small screens put it inside kit Drawer (the app-shell example shows one way).
Gray placeholder shapes in the layout of content that is still loading, like lines of text, an avatar, or an image, so the page keeps its shape until the data arrives.
Simple semantic table for invoices, lists, and text rows. Search and filters belong on DataTable. One piece.
Calm processing indicator for assistants and short system waits.
Vertical sequence of now, next, and later for ordered multi-stage work.
A short note that floats in after an action, like Saved successfully, and goes away on its own after a few seconds, with an optional Undo.
One-open disclosure list for short related sections.
Nested hierarchy people open and close level by level to browse, pick, or check items.
A list of usage limits, one a row: the limit's name, how much is used of it, a bar, and a short note.
Inline status banner that stays on the page.
Must-choose overlay that interrupts until the user cancels or confirms.
Face or initials for a person. Not a status chip and not a button.
Overlapping row of kit Avatars with an optional leftover count.
Choose one of a few visible options in a joined track. role=radiogroup, sm or md, icons optional.
Selectable cards for a plan or option picker. Single or multi select, with title, description, and a price or meta slot.
A shortcut chip for one keyboard key. Place several in a row for a chord.
The agent asks before it acts: risk, exact command or diff, keyboard-first Approve / Deny.
Vertical step list for a running agent task: done, running or awaiting approval, pending.
What an agent intends to do: edit, accept, run, skip, stop, or retry its steps.
Several agents side by side with sub-agent progress, cost, and time; one opens into its sub-agent tree.
One agent tool call on one line with a live timer; opens to arguments and result; groups several calls.
An agent asks for standing access, scope by scope, with why and expiry; Grant / Deny.
Compact strip of running agents for a header (row) or sidebar (stack).
One agent at work: live clock, cost, a time strip of steps, and the pending action to approve.
An orchestrator and its sub-agents as a tree; status, time and rolled-up cost per node.
One lane per agent over a time window: blocks, handoffs, decisions on the block.
Queue of approvals, questions, failures and recaps from agents, with a detail pane.
An agent asks the person to choose or answer mid-run; confirm or skip.
How far an agent may go without asking: readable stops on a SegmentedControl.
Redirect, pause or stop a running agent; stop confirms in an AlertDialog.
Choose a model: grouped by vendor with context window, cost tier and disabled reasons.
How full the prompt context is, by segment, with a near-limit warning and Trim oldest.
Assistant reply with inline citation marks and a source list; missing sources flagged.
Action row on a chat message: copy, retry or edit, feedback, More menu.
Proposed edits to accept or reject in place: unified, split or inline, with + / − marks.
An agent's stored facts: search, add, pin, edit or forget, and which this thread used.
Where a run's time and money went: model, tool and approval spans with totals and detail.
Plan usage or credits against a limit; composes Meter, UsageList, LineChart and Alert.
First-run checklist: overall progress and one action per task; feeds onboarding screens.
In-app notification inbox: bell with unread count and a popover list; not a Toast.
"What moved" card: before → after and a delta per metric, with good or bad per metric.
A/B or A/B/n experiment card: status, traffic split, metric per variant and one decision.
One comment conversation on a document or record: comments, one level of replies, edit and a composer.
Side panel for a page's comment threads: Open / Resolved / All, previews and the selected thread.
Filterable catalogue of integrations: search, category filter and one Connect per tile.
In-product plan comparison: Monthly / Yearly switch, price, features and one CTA per plan.
Invoice or credit note document view: status, bill-to, lines, totals and one line about payment.
Kanban board of columns and task cards; move by drag or keyboard (Space, arrows, Space).
A tiny wrapper that crossfades one child to the next when its key changes, for status and value swaps. A motion primitive, not a Card.
A short heading that rises in by word or by line, for docs heroes and empty states.
A kit Card that tilts a few degrees toward the pointer, for rare showcase spots. Never the default Card.
A quiet line or dot grid behind a demo or hero, fading out toward the edges. Decorative only.
A restrained, token-based gradient fill for one rare heading. Real text, no motion.
Block: home for a fleet of agents. Since-you-last-looked summary, every agent on one time axis, and an inbox of what waits on you, under one filter.
summary: See what your agents did since you last looked, what is running, and what needs you.

intent: Block: trusted-by wall. Rows of named logos looping in opposite directions with soft edges; still under reduced motion.
summary: A trusted-by wall: rows of named customer logos drifting in opposite directions, with soft edges.

intent: Block: pricing section. PricingPlans with its Monthly / Yearly switch and an FAQ Accordion.
summary: A pricing section: plans with a monthly / yearly switch and the questions people ask before they buy.

intent: Block: work alongside running agents. Chat, who is working, one inline approval and steering for one agent.
summary: Work alongside agents while they run: talk, see who is working, steer one, and approve what they ask.

intent: Block: one agent run in detail. Monitor, the selected step's tool call, who started whom and the step log, on one selected step.
summary: One agent run on one screen: clock and cost, every step, who started whom, and the selected step's tool call.

intent: Block: browse, search and connect apps. Connected chip over the IntegrationPicker catalogue; a tile opens a Drawer with detail and Connect / Disconnect.
summary: Browse, search and connect the apps your workspace works with.

intent: Block: a task board with detail. TaskBoard columns; a card opens a Drawer with Status and Assignee Fields and its CommentThread.
summary: Move tasks across a board, then open one to set its status, assignee and talk it through.

intent: Block: the top of a dashboard. A Scoreboard of three or four KPIs that is also the picker, a LineChart of the picked KPI, a DataTable of the top rows behind it, and one range control (SegmentedControl) that changes all of them.
summary: Pick a KPI to chart it and list its top rows, with one range for all.

intent: Block: plan usage and what it costs. The main allowance (UsageMeter) beside the plan card with Upgrade as the one solid primary and Manage payment, then the other limits (UsageList) beside recent invoices (ListView, a Download action per row).
summary: The main allowance, other limits, recent invoices and the plan with Upgrade.

intent: Block: what happened across a workspace. Events from people and agents grouped by day, Type and Person filters, Open / Reply per event, Load more.
summary: See what people and agents did across the workspace, by day, filtered by type or person.

intent: Block: approve an agent's plan before it runs. AgentPlan steps, ChangeSummary of what it changes, AutonomyDial, and Approve / Request changes / Reject.
summary: Approve an agent's plan before it runs: its steps, what it changes, and how much it may do alone.

intent: Block: review an agent's change set. ChangeSummary, a ListView of changed files beside the selected file's InlineDiff and CommentThread; accept or reject per file, Accept all.
summary: Review what an agent changed: file by file, with the diff, comments, and accept or reject.

intent: Dashboard example: PageHeader, Scoreboard, LineChart, Section, DataTable.
Settings example: PageHeader, Fields, and save actions.
List-detail example: AppNav, Table, and detail Section.
First-run page: PageHeader, outlined Empty, and one primary that opens a create Modal.
Layout example (one option of many): AppHeader over SideNav when wide; below 64rem a Menu Button in AppHeader opens the same nav in a left Drawer.
Sign-in / sign-up page example: centred Card, Field-wrapped email and password, one primary, 'or' Divider, SSO buttons.
Billing schedule example: Section, next charge, failed-payment Alert, and charges in a Table with status Badges.
Integration settings example: Section with status Badge, FieldSet of Fields (Select, Switch), scope Tags, Save, and a confirmed Disconnect.
Settings pages example, Stage look: Profile, Billing, Team, Notifications and Security with their states, on the inset panel of a layout-shell--inset shell whose SideNav lists the sections.
Onboarding example: reduced AppHeader with ProgressSteps, Welcome / Workspace / Connect (SetupGuide) / Done steps, Back and one primary in a footer bar, with validation error and submitting states.
